analysis.title: BWX Technologies (BWXT) - Investor Day Reflections, EU M&A, HALEU and DUECE
key_insights: Seaport maintains Buy and a $245 price target on BWXT, based on a 2030E EV/EBITDA of 23. The stock was $131.20 at the time of the note, against a 52-week range of $123.05 - $241.82.

At the 9/29/26 Investor Day, management said 2023-2026 expected results beat its February 2024 targets: revenue CAGR ~15% vs mid-single-digit target, adjusted EBITDA CAGR ~12% vs mid-to-high single digit, free cash flow CAGR ~18% vs double-digit. Revenue growth includes acquisitions, with ~8.5% organic CAGR.

Seaport sees BWXT as execution-oriented and finds no history of hyperbole in its guidance. Management called the new 2030 targets ambitious but pointed to backlog visibility, differentiated capabilities, capacity investment and operating improvements.

Backlog is $8.4 billion, more than 2x the year-end 2023 level. Management ties demand to defense requirements, energy security, AI-driven electricity demand, new reactor construction and refurbishment of the existing fleet.

2030 guidance: revenue $5.5-$6.0B, adjusted EBITDA $1.1-$1.2B at ~20% margin, free cash flow $525-$575M. The 2027 preliminary framework is high-single-digit growth in revenue and adjusted EBITDA with modest margin expansion.

Seaport models the lower end of 2030 guidance (revenue $5,484MM, EBITDA about $1,006MM). It says upside would come from faster commercial orders or new government procurement such as PELE, BANR or the nuclear battleship.

Seaport screened EU acquisition candidates in three themes: fuel qualification and materials testing (Studsvik), nuclear lifecycle services (Assystem, Onet Technologies, James Fisher Nuclear) and heavy industrial manufacturing (Walter Tosto, FOMAS, Paralloy). It found no candidates that look like imminent acquisitions.

Seaport concludes further M&A is more likely to come from a specific capability gap or a motivated seller than from a wish for a bigger European footprint. Any deal must meet the Slide 73 criteria: differentiated capabilities, revenue synergies, positive NPV, first-year EPS accretion and margin-accretive growth.

On 10/22/26 BWXT said no decision had been made on a rumored Polish investment and that 'any investment would depend on firm orders and the extent of the opportunity.' Seaport reads this as applying to organic investment too.

Kinectrics, acquired in 2025, gives BWXT its European presence. It opened a Cernavodă, Romania engineering hub in November 2024 with more than 50 staff, and won a €3.9MM Nuclearelectrica contract in February 2026.

BWXT's DUECE contract is worth $1.5B. It industrializes ORNL's small centrifuge technology and prepares the Erwin, Tennessee pilot plant to enrich HALEU to HEU. The contract excludes the LEU and HALEU stages.

CEO Rex Geveden said the upstream LEU and HALEU stages could represent 'tens of billions' of dollars of work, and BWXT intends to compete for them. It was acknowledged that a fully unobligated supply chain could be less cost-competitive than commercial enrichment.

Per the GAO August 2026 report, DUECE pilot operations begin around 2035 and the transition to HEU enrichment comes around 2049. Existing unobligated LEU for tritium production lasts into the early 2040s and naval HEU into the 2050s.
Seaport estimates: FY2026E revenue $3,823MM, EBITDA $619.1MM, GAAP EPS $4.48. FY2027E revenue $4,173MM, EBITDA $780.1MM, EPS $5.60. FY2030E revenue $5,484MM, EBITDA $1,006MM, EPS $7.30.

market_movers.rationale: Seaport keeps Buy after the Investor Day. Management's record of beating its own targets and its 2030 guidance support the view, and the target uses a 2030E EV/EBITDA of 23.

sector_views.rationale: Seaport describes nuclear demand as inflecting across defense and commercial power, driven by AI electricity demand, new reactor construction and fleet refurbishment.

earnings_insights: Seaport FY2026E (estimates): revenue $3,823MM, adjusted EBITDA $619.1MM, GAAP EPS $4.48. 1Q26 was reported at revenue $860.6MM, EPS $0.99 GAAP and EBITDA $135.6MM. 2Q26 was reported at revenue $901.6MM, EPS $0.97 GAAP and EBITDA $145.4MM.
Seaport 3Q26E (estimate, not yet reported): revenue $993.9MM, GAAP EPS $1.15, EBITDA $156.4MM. 4Q26E: revenue $1,109MM, EPS $1.36, EBITDA $181.7MM.
Seaport FY2027E (estimates): revenue $4,173MM, GAAP EPS $5.60, EBITDA $780.1MM. FY2028E: revenue $4,502MM, EPS $5.94, EBITDA $836.0MM.
Seaport FY2030E (estimates): revenue $5,484MM, GAAP EPS $7.30, EBITDA $1,006MM. Seaport's P/E on its estimates is 29.3x for 2026E, 23.4x for 2027E and 18.0x for 2030E.

trade_ideas.description: Buy BWXT with a $245 price target based on a 2030E EV/EBITDA multiple of 23
trade_ideas.rationale: Management has beaten its prior Investor Day targets, backlog is $8.4B, and 2030 guidance points to compounding double-digit earnings and free cash flow growth.

risk_factors: Management called the 2030 targets ambitious, and 'there is no such thing as riskless forecasting.'
The unobligated enrichment program could be less cost-competitive than commercial enrichment.
Further M&A and organic investment such as Poland depend on firm orders and project visibility.
The final plant configuration and allocation of responsibilities for LEU and HALEU production remain unsettled publicly.
The LEU and HALEU stages are outside BWXT's current $1.5B DUECE contract and are competitive.
vol_and_positioning: Short interest is 3.3MM shares against a float of 91.3MM. Average daily volume is 1,216k shares.
geopolitical: BWXT issued a press release on 10/22/26 about rumors of an impending Polish investment and said no investment decision had been made.
DUECE is part of an NNSA program to give the U.S. military a fully unobligated (domestic-content only) uranium enrichment chain, so no foreign party can interfere.
